issues.issue: Can the applicant complain that the reasons were inadequate when he never asked the officer for more reasons?
issues.applicant_position: Adequacy of reasons was in issue; the refusal letter and CAIPS notes did not explain the decision.
issues.respondent_position: Applicant never requested fuller reasons, so he cannot complain of inadequate reasons (Marine Atlantic).
issues.result_quote: This ground of the applicant's judicial review must be rejected.
